items.title: George "Pops" Foster and Mugsy Spanier Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: I bought, I had to buy it at what it mean to Lorenzo Stoyle, bought, paid three dollars for a horn out of the pawn shop for a-

ctx.x: Oh yeah, we saw a punch coming. He's got the power. But he don't know his horn. You don't know him, huh? No. You know Guy Kelly? He sounds like- You remember Guy Kelly?

Yeah. Well look, if you see him, you see Guy Kelly, you see him. Look just like him for the world. Guy Kelly worked for him, brother. Yeah, I bought, I had to buy it at what it mean to Lorenzo Stoyle, bought, paid three dollars for a horn out of the pawn shop for a- We couldn't punch, he didn't have no horn. Then he made us mad, we were going to take the horn, but Jack Carey, much Carey's brother, stopped him from taking the horn. I had the hatchet to chop the horn in half. I was going to give Stoyle's his half…
